# dsh-emoji-wallet
> A minimal DeepSeek balance wallet for DeepSeek Harness: one click shows your API balance right in

the session header.
>
> DSH 余额小钱包：顶栏一个 💰，点一下就知道 DeepSeek API 还剩多少钱。
## Features / 功能
- 💰 **One-click balance** — a small wallet button in the session header (right side, next to Session

log)
- 🔒 **Key never leaves the host** — the browser only ever sees the balance numbers; the API ke

y is read from the harness credentials file (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`) on the host
- 🫧 **Semi-tran

sparent bubble** — click to open, click again to close (auto-closes after 8s)
- 🎛️ **No config neede
d** — reads `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` automatically
